notes: This file is the release SCOPE of the wire contract: which proto packages a release publishes as frozen, and which are deliberately withheld. release-manifest.proto_packages is generated from released[].

It is frozen in both directions. released[] plus withheld[] must equal exactly the set of packages found under proto/, and the two must be disjoint: a new package cannot be silently published, and it cannot be silently omitted either. tools/release-manifest enforces this before it will emit a manifest.

A withheld package stays in proto/ and keeps passing buf lint and buf breaking. Withholding says only that its fields are not frozen yet, so a release makes no compatibility promise about it - release/README.md requires that the fields intended for the cutover are frozen, and a package whose domain is still awaiting registration does not meet that.

bus.v1 was withheld in v0.1.1 pending two upstream decisions. Both are now closed, so it is released here: payload_digest is now a registered H_V1 commitment under TRUEOPEN_BUS_PAYLOAD_V2 rather than a fourth bare SHA-256, and TRUEOPEN_BUS_ENVELOPE_V2 has a registry row with its ordered 13-field projection. Both domains carry cross-language conformance vectors in testdata/v1/bus/.
cortex.v1 arrives in v0.2.1, moved here from TrueOpen/cortex so the SDK and Cortex read one source instead of a copy. It is withheld; see its reason below.

withheld.reason: Fields are not frozen. ADR-0022 is still open and its back-write matrix assigns Cortex further changes to chat_input - an output_decoding block, a tool_calling block, and manifest_version 3 - so a release that promised compatibility here would have to break it. Release once ADR-0022 is adopted and those fields have landed.
